documents.name: Objection_LA1024.txt
documents.text: We are objecting to the land acquisition of our ancestral field for the highway bypass. The valuation of ₹8,50,000 is extremely low compared to the current market value. We require compensation of at least ₹15,00,000 or we will approach the civil court to seek a stay order.

documents.name: DisputeStatement_LA1025.txt
documents.text: The ownership of partition No. 4 under survey 142/2 is disputed between myself and my three brothers. The title deed is held in court registry. No compensation should be released to any individual until court orders are passed.
